tiers.Operating profile: Basic capacity, single path, shutdowns required for maintenance.
Redundant capacity components, but maintenance can still require shutdowns.
Concurrently maintainable with redundant paths and no planned shutdown for maintenance.
Fault tolerant with multiple isolated systems and highest resilience level.

notes.Observation: Current Uptime Institute Tier documentation focuses on topology, maintainability, and fault tolerance by tier.
notes.Why it matters: Use the uptime percentages as planning benchmarks, not as contractual SLA values embedded in the current Tier standard.
